Pakistan Cricket Board Relocates Matches Due to Political Unrest

The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has relocated matches of the President's Trophy from Peshawar and Abbottabad due to political turmoil and the imposition of governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Several matches originally scheduled for these locations have been moved.
